# theboringoffice

> A virtual office for AI coding agents. Terminal UI where an opencode boss and sub-agents clock in as coworkers on a living floor — chat, board, mail, work threads, and permission queue in one place.

This file helps AI assistants and crawlers understand the site. Prefer these pages over guessing.

## Primary

- [Home](https://theboringoffice.pages.dev/): product overview and install path
- [Get started](https://theboringoffice.pages.dev/get-started): install CLI, demo mode, live office
- [Docs](https://theboringoffice.pages.dev/docs): how the office works
- [Vision](https://theboringoffice.pages.dev/vision): why a virtual office for agents
- [Blog](https://theboringoffice.pages.dev/blog): product and engineering posts
- [RSS](https://theboringoffice.pages.dev/rss.xml): full post feed

## Product facts

- Native Go CLI (single binary). Not Electron.
- Boss = real `opencode` session; employees = opencode sub-agents.
- Demo: `theboringoffice --demo`
- Install: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theboringhumane/theboringoffice/main/install.sh | sh`
- Source: https://github.com/theboringhumane/theboringoffice

- Sitemap: https://theboringoffice.pages.dev/sitemap.xml
